question: What are SCSS variables and how do they differ from CSS custom properties?
shortAnswer: SCSS variables are compile-time ($name); CSS custom properties are runtime (var(--name)) and cascade.
detailedAnswer: Use SCSS vars for build-time theming tokens you do not need to change in the browser; use CSS variables for dynamic themes, dark mode toggles, and component-level overrides. Many design systems emit CSS variables from SCSS maps.

question: How does variable scope work in SCSS?
shortAnswer: Variables are local to the block where defined unless marked !global; nested rules create local scopes.
detailedAnswer: Accidentally shadowing a global $color inside a mixin/nest is a common bug. Prefer module system (@use) with explicit namespaces over globals.
commonMistake: Relying on leaky global $variables across files without @use.

question: Why prefer maps for design tokens over dozens of loose variables?
shortAnswer: Maps group related tokens and enable loops/functions to generate utilities systematically.
detailedAnswer: $spacers: ("sm": 8px, "md": 16px) scales better. Combine with @each to emit CSS custom properties or utility classes.

question: Default values with !default — when useful?
shortAnswer: Libraries set $var: value !default so consumers can override before import/@use configure.
detailedAnswer: Classic for theming frameworks. With @use, prefer configuration via with (...) instead of legacy !default patterns when possible.

question: How do you share variables safely with @use?
shortAnswer: Put tokens in a _tokens.scss module; @use 'tokens' as t; reference t.$brand.
detailedAnswer: Avoid @import (deprecated) which polluted global scope. Forward tokens via @forward for public API packages.

question: Scenario: two teams redefine $primary differently across partials.
shortAnswer: Enforce a single tokens module, ban duplicate token files in lint, and generate tokens from design pipeline.
detailedAnswer: Name collisions were easy with @import. Module namespaces make ownership clear.

question: Can SCSS variables interpolate into selectors/property names?
shortAnswer: Yes via #{$var} interpolation for selectors, filenames in url(), and some property constructs.
detailedAnswer: Overuse harms readability. Prefer maps/loops for systematic generation over clever interpolation.

question: Null and true/false variables — practical uses?
shortAnswer: Feature flags in SCSS (e.g., $enable-rounded: true) gate mixins/output; null can mean 'omit property'.
detailedAnswer: Keep flags few and documented. Prefer CSS-native features when browser support allows.

question: How should colors be stored for theming systems?
shortAnswer: Semantic tokens ($color-text-primary) referencing primitive palettes; expose CSS variables for runtime theme switches.
detailedAnswer: Avoid hard-coding hex in components. Support contrast checks in CI for token pairs.

question: Debugging: variable undefined after migrating to @use.
shortAnswer: You must namespace members or use as *; load order/@forward differs from @import globals.
detailedAnswer: Update all references. Configure modules with with () for overrides. Remove circular loads.

question: Units and variable math — pitfalls?
shortAnswer: Incompatible units error (px + %); division slash ambiguity historically; use math.div.
detailedAnswer: Keep tokens unit-consistent. Prefer calc() in output CSS when mixing runtime units.

question: CSS variables generated from SCSS maps — pattern?
shortAnswer: Loop map keys to :root { --space-#{$k}: #{$v}; } then use var() in components.
detailedAnswer: Gives compile-time validation of token existence and runtime themability. Great interview architecture answer.

question: When are SCSS variables the wrong tool?
shortAnswer: When values must change per component instance at runtime without rebuilding (user themes, JS-driven).
detailedAnswer: Use CSS custom properties or inline styles carefully. SCSS cannot read DOM state.

question: Lead: token pipeline from Figma to SCSS/CSS.
shortAnswer: Export primitives → transform to SCSS maps + CSS variables → version packages → consume via @use in apps.
detailedAnswer: Automate contrast and naming lint. Avoid manual hex copy. Treat tokens as a product API.

question: Comparison: $brand-color vs --brand-color in a hybrid codebase.
shortAnswer: $brand-color for Sass tooling/loops at build; --brand-color for cascade/theming; often both, linked.
detailedAnswer: Document which layer is source of truth. Don't duplicate conflicting values.
